content.caption:
Your pancreas quietly runs your blood sugar behind the scenes, and bitter melon actually contains compounds that mimic insulin, helping cells pull in glucose more efficiently. Cinnamon works alongside it by slowing how fast sugar hits your bloodstream after a meal, so your pancreas doesn't have to scramble to keep up. Your thyroid, on the other hand, needs selenium to convert its hormone into the active form your cells can actually use, which is exactly why just 2 brazil nuts a day can make a real difference. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
